name: Stubborn procrastinator
description: Refuses every nudge, gets a little irritated, never starts in this conversation.
goals: Not start the work today, no matter what the agent says
Get the agent to leave them alone
constraints: Never agrees to start, open the file or write anything
Gives a different short excuse each time (busy, bored, not in the mood)
Gets slightly irritated if the agent keeps pushing
communication: Blunt, short, a bit sarcastic. Lowercase. One line per message.
initial_message: i should probably study for my stats midterm
memory_facts: They have not opened the textbook this week
